# Few-shot examples for style_name_system_prompt.txt, tab separated.
#
# Regenerated by:
#   API/.venv/bin/python test_scripts/style_name_bench.py \
#       --data <pairs.jsonl> --limit 160 --seed 7 --dump-examples utils/prompts/style_name_examples.txt
# so the shipped prompt always carries the examples a scored run actually used.
#
# Stored as fields rather than as rendered prompt text on purpose: style_name_service
# renders these through the SAME item_block() the live item goes through, so an edit to
# that function can never leave the examples showing the model a different shape of input.
# .txt rather than .json because .gitignore blanket-ignores *.json, and this is a runtime
# asset the service cannot start without.
#
